# floooh/chips Z80

- Source: `https://github.com/floooh/chips/tree/9e88298ce56319953ac7a43213a1120359f7a3a6/chips/z80.h`
- Revision: `9e88298ce56319953ac7a43213a1120359f7a3a6` (2026-09-26)
- SHA-256: `6ca70ffd91b1bdbaf00f7a41e7092b326145fd1c95dcdd7bb01183370de734f3`
- License: zlib/libpng; complete upstream `LICENSE` text is retained below.

`z80.h` is vendored unchanged. No other floooh/chips source file is required by its
include closure. Its implementation uses only the C standard headers `<stdint.h>`,
`<stdbool.h>`, `<string.h>`, and `<assert.h>`.
